messages:
sarah: FYI nightly eval flagged a bunch of function-calling failures, schema validation errors across the func_calls promptset. full log attached by eval-ci below. :warning:
ken: can you paste the example failing response?
maya: saw the alert, triaging now — adding ken + devon.
eval-ci: nightly-run 2026-03-20T03:00Z finished with 62 failed items in regressions/func_calls.json, failure mode: JSON schema mismatch at root.args (expected object, got string). see snippet:```
-- model request --
promptset_item: "lookup_store_hours"
model: redwood/v2-12b-quant
call_mode: function_calling
-- model response (raw) --
{"name":"get_store_info","args":"{\\\"store_id\\\": 1234}"}  <-- args is a STRING not an object
```
devon: interesting — looks like model returned a serialized JSON string inside args, not an object. could be temperature/formatting or quantization artifact.
sarah: this is what tripped the eval harness schema check (we require args to be parsed JSON). downstream runner tries to parse and fails with JSON.parse error.
ken: quick hypothesis list: 1) quantized kernel causes stray quoting/escape differences, 2) model checkpoint variant has a formatting prompt regression, 3) tokenization changes produce extra escapes.
maya: run a repro locally with same prompt and --no-quant flag to isolate. command:```
./eval/run_promptset --model redwood/v2-12b-quant --promptset regressions/func_calls.json --item lookup_store_hours --save-output /tmp/failed.json
```
ken: ok re-ran with quantized and non-quantized: quantized reproduces failure, unquantized returns proper args object:```
quantized -> {"name":"get_store_info","args":"{\\\"store_id\\\":1234}"}
unquantized -> {"name":"get_store_info","args":{"store_id":1234}}
```
sarah: thanks — that pretty much nails quantization as suspect. any idea why quantized variant is escaping?
devon: sometimes quantized decoding can favor different token boundaries causing extra escapes when model emits JSON-like strings. also the model's instruction-following head can output a quoted blob if it's uncertain about whether to produce code vs string.
maya: short-term mitigation: make eval harness tolerant — attempt JSON.parse on args, and if that yields a string, attempt JSON.parse again to unescape double-serialized args. also add a metric to count double-serialized responses.
ken: agree for harness. medium-term: open a model-onboard issue to repro across different seeds and prompt templates. add a minimal prompt that forces structured output, e.g., `Return EXACT JSON object for args without surrounding quotes.`
sarah: can we rollback the nightly baseline to the last good unquantized run while we triage? customers on Dedicated might be using quantized builds though.
deploy-bot: rollback request queued for dedicated staging; awaiting approval.
devon: we should also add a guard in serving runtime: when using function_calling mode, if the model returns args as a raw string, try to auto-parse it. fallback path: convert to parsed args if valid, otherwise mark as schema error and surface full raw output in logs.
maya: I'll PR harness changes tonight (defensive double-parse + metric). ken — can you start an experiment comparing v2-12b-quant with v2-12b-int8 across same promptset? put results in #eng-ml/regressions board.
ken: on it — will run both seeds and push CSV. estimated runtime 45m.
sarah: also capture token-level diffs and decoder logprobs for the tokens around the opening brace — might reveal whether quantized model adds a stray backslash token.
devon: note for onboarding: add a check in our model verification suite that enforces schema adherence for function calling across quantized variants before promoting to catalog.
maya: created GH issue 4812: "double-serialized args from quantized models in function_calling" and linked eval logs. tagging research + runtime.
eval-ci: re-run scheduled in 1h after harness patch (if merged).
sarah: thx — keep thread updated. I'll block the nightly baseline promotion until we have a fix or clear mitigation. :memo:
